Ui.Script:
-- ── Constants (ref Blizzard_CraftUI.lua:2-4) ──────────────────────────────────────────────── local CRAFTS_DISPLAYED = 8 -- CRAFTS_DISPLAYED (ref l.2) local MAX_CRAFT_REAGENTS = 8 -- MAX_CRAFT_REAGENTS (ref l.3) local CRAFT_SKILL_HEIGHT = 16 -- CRAFT_SKILL_HEIGHT (ref l.4)
-- The recipe-row color table (ref l.6-13), transcribed verbatim including "header"/"used"/ -- "none" — all UNREACHABLE in v1 (this file's header comment, deviation 1). CraftSubTypeColor -- (ref l.15-22) is DROPPED outright — dead ref code, deviation 9. CraftTypeColor = {} CraftTypeColor["optimal"] = { r = 1.00, g = 0.50, b = 0.25 } CraftTypeColor["medium"] = { r = 1.00, g = 1.00, b = 0.00 } CraftTypeColor["easy"] = { r = 0.25, g = 0.75, b = 0.25 } CraftTypeColor["trivial"] = { r = 0.50, g = 0.50, b = 0.50 } CraftTypeColor["used"] = { r = 0.50, g = 0.50, b = 0.50 } CraftTypeColor["header"] = { r = 1.00, g = 0.82, b = 0 } CraftTypeColor["none"] = { r = 0.25, g = 0.75, b = 0.25 }
-- ── GlobalStrings the ref reads (byte-exact 1.12 enUS, this file's header comment cites the -- extraction + the CREATE-must-be-global exception) — chunk-local except CREATE. ───────────── local REQUIRES_LABEL = "Requires:" -- REQUIRES_LABEL (GlobalStrings.lua:3339) local PARENS_TEMPLATE = "(%s)" -- PARENS_TEMPLATE (2984) local EXIT_LABEL = "Exit" -- EXIT (1933) CREATE = CREATE or "Create" -- CREATE (871) -- REAL global, see header comment
-- BuildColoredListString is REUSED from TradeSkillFrame.xml (already a true global by the time -- this file loads — this file's header comment, deviation 2). No redefinition here.
-- ── Detail pane ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── -- No crafts known at all (ref l.131-150): blank the whole detail pane. Regions on this window's -- own Layers "hide" via SetText("") — TradeSkillFrame.xml's own convention, which predates -- region Show/Hide (region.rs has the real pair now); equivalent either way. function BenillaCraftFrame_HideDetails() getglobal("BenillaCraftFrameTitleText"):SetText(GetCraftName()) getglobal("BenillaCraftName"):SetText("") getglobal("BenillaCraftRequirements"):SetText("") getglobal("BenillaCraftDescription"):SetText("") getglobal("BenillaCraftIcon"):Hide() for i = 1, MAX_CRAFT_REAGENTS do getglobal("BenillaCraftReagent" .. i):Hide() end getglobal("BenillaCraftCreateButton"):Disable() end
-- Fill the detail pane for the selected recipe `id` (ref CraftFrame_SetSelection, l.285-408; -- the header branch is dropped — deviation 1, never reached). Also the SOURCE of the selection -- highlight's color (set once here, ref l.305-306). function BenillaCraftFrame_SetSelection(id) if not id or id == 0 then BenillaCraftFrame_HideDetails() return end SelectCraft(id) if GetCraftSelectionIndex() > GetNumCrafts() then return end local craftName, craftSubSpellName, craftType = GetCraftInfo(id) local color = CraftTypeColor[craftType] if color then getglobal("BenillaCraftHighlight"):SetVertexColor(color.r, color.g, color.b) end
-- General info (ref l.308-320). getglobal("BenillaCraftFrameTitleText"):SetText(GetCraftName()) getglobal("BenillaCraftName"):SetText(craftName) local icon = getglobal("BenillaCraftIcon") icon:Show() icon:SetNormalTexture(GetCraftIcon(id) or BENILLA_FALLBACK_ICON)
-- The description + the Reagents label's DYNAMIC reposition (ref l.312-318, transcribed -- verbatim): when there's a description, the label sits 10px below its bottom edge; when -- there isn't, it sits directly where the (blank) description would have been. if GetCraftDescription(id) then getglobal("BenillaCraftDescription"):SetText(GetCraftDescription(id)) getglobal("BenillaCraftReagentLabel"):SetPoint("TOPLEFT", "BenillaCraftDescription", "BOTTOMLEFT", 0, -10) else getglobal("BenillaCraftDescription"):SetText(" ") getglobal("BenillaCraftReagentLabel"):SetPoint("TOPLEFT", "BenillaCraftDescription", "TOPLEFT", 0, 0) end
-- Reagents (ref l.321-359): up to MAX_CRAFT_REAGENTS, gray-out + creatable gate. local creatable = true local numReagents = GetCraftNumReagents(id) for i = 1, MAX_CRAFT_REAGENTS do local reagent = getglobal("BenillaCraftReagent" .. i) if i <= numReagents then local reagentName, reagentTexture, need, have = GetCraftReagentInfo(id, i) if not reagentName or not reagentTexture then -- Item template not landed yet for this reagent — hide it, like the ref does -- for any nil reagent (engine API note, decision 0437). reagent:Hide() else reagent:Show() reagent.icon:SetTexture(reagentTexture) reagent.name:SetText(reagentName) have = have or 0 if have < need then reagent.icon:SetVertexColor(0.5, 0.5, 0.5) reagent.name:SetTextColor(GRAY_FONT_COLOR.r, GRAY_FONT_COLOR.g, GRAY_FONT_COLOR.b) creatable = false else reagent.icon:SetVertexColor(1.0, 1.0, 1.0) reagent.name:SetTextColor(HIGHLIGHT_FONT_COLOR.r, HIGHLIGHT_FONT_COLOR.g, HIGHLIGHT_FONT_COLOR.b) end local haveText = have if have >= 100 then haveText = "*" end reagent.count:SetText(haveText .. " /" .. need) end else reagent:Hide() end end
-- Requires: line (ref l.361-372) — ONE concatenated FontString, unlike TradeSkill's split -- Label+Text pair (Craft's own ref genuinely differs here — this file's header comment -- points at TradeSkillFrame.xml's split for comparison). The pet-level fallback branch -- (ref l.364-369) is unreachable in v1 (deviation 6) and dropped. local requiredTotems = BuildColoredListString(GetCraftSpellFocus(id)) if requiredTotems then getglobal("BenillaCraftRequirements"):SetText(REQUIRES_LABEL .. " " .. requiredTotems) else getglobal("BenillaCraftRequirements"):SetText("") end
if creatable then getglobal("BenillaCraftCreateButton"):Enable() else getglobal("BenillaCraftCreateButton"):Disable() end end
-- ── The list page (ref CraftFrame_Update, l.99-283 — the header/expand-icon/training-points -- tail is dropped: deviations 1/6, never reached in v1) ──────────────────────────────────────── function BenillaCraftFrame_Update() getglobal("BenillaCraftFrameTitleText"):SetText(GetCraftName()) getglobal("BenillaCraftCreateButton"):SetText(getglobal(GetCraftButtonToken()))
local numCrafts = GetNumCrafts() if numCrafts == 0 then BenillaCraftFrame_HideDetails() else getglobal("BenillaCraftCollapseAllButton"):Enable() -- ref l.158 (no matching Disable() -- anywhere in Craft's own ref — a real asymmetry vs. TradeSkill's own l.86/94 pair, -- transcribed as-is, not "fixed"). end
local scrollFrame = getglobal("BenillaCraftListScrollFrame") FauxScrollFrame_Update(scrollFrame, numCrafts, CRAFTS_DISPLAYED, CRAFT_SKILL_HEIGHT) local craftOffset = FauxScrollFrame_GetOffset(scrollFrame)
-- The skill-rank StatusBar (ref l.107-123): Show/Hide are real here (real widgets, not -- flattened Layer regions). local name, rank, maxRank = GetCraftDisplaySkillLine() local rankFrame = getglobal("BenillaCraftRankFrame") if name then getglobal("BenillaCraftRankFrameSkillName"):SetText(name) rankFrame:SetStatusBarColor(0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 0.5) getglobal("BenillaCraftRankFrameBackground"):SetVertexColor(0.0, 0.0, 0.75, 0.5) rankFrame:SetMinMaxValues(0, maxRank) rankFrame:SetValue(rank) getglobal("BenillaCraftRankFrameSkillRank"):SetText(rank .. "/" .. maxRank) rankFrame:Show() getglobal("BenillaCraftSkillBorderLeft"):Show() getglobal("BenillaCraftSkillBorderRight"):Show() else rankFrame:Hide() getglobal("BenillaCraftSkillBorderLeft"):Hide() getglobal("BenillaCraftSkillBorderRight"):Hide() end
local highlight = getglobal("BenillaCraftHighlightFrame") highlight:Hide()
local selection = GetCraftSelectionIndex() for i = 1, CRAFTS_DISPLAYED do local craftIndex = i + craftOffset local button = getglobal("BenillaCraft" .. i) if craftIndex <= numCrafts then local craftName, craftSubSpellName, craftType, numAvailable = GetCraftInfo(craftIndex) button.craftIndex = craftIndex local color = CraftTypeColor[craftType] if color then button.name:SetTextColor(color.r, color.g, color.b) end if (numAvailable or 0) == 0 then button.name:SetText(" " .. craftName) else button.name:SetText(" " .. craftName .. " [" .. numAvailable .. "]") end if craftSubSpellName and craftSubSpellName ~= "" then button.subtext:SetText(format(PARENS_TEMPLATE, craftSubSpellName)) else button.subtext:SetText("") end button:Show() if selection == craftIndex then highlight:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", button, "TOPLEFT", 0, 0) highlight:Show() end else button.craftIndex = nil button:Hide() end end
-- Count headers + how many stay folded (ref l.249-259), to drive the CollapseAll tab's own -- texture below — restored, deviation 1 (still functionally inert: GetCraftInfo never -- returns "header" in v1, so numHeaders is always 0 here). local numHeaders, notExpanded = 0, 0 for i = 1, numCrafts do local craftName, craftSubSpellName, craftType, numAvailable, isExpanded = GetCraftInfo(i) if craftName and craftType == "header" then numHeaders = numHeaders + 1 if not isExpanded then notExpanded = notExpanded + 1 end end end -- If all headers are not expanded then show the collapse texture, otherwise the expand one -- (ref l.261-267). local collapseAll = getglobal("BenillaCraftCollapseAllButton") if notExpanded ~= numHeaders then collapseAll.collapsed = nil collapseAll:SetNormalTexture("Interface\\Buttons\\UI-MinusButton-Up") else collapseAll.collapsed = true collapseAll:SetNormalTexture("Interface\\Buttons\\UI-PlusButton-Up") end -- Show the tab only when there are headers to fold (ref l.269-282; the row-text-reposition -- loops there stay dropped, deviation 1) — always Hidden in v1 since numHeaders is always 0. if numHeaders > 0 then getglobal("BenillaCraftExpandButtonFrame"):Show() else getglobal("BenillaCraftExpandButtonFrame"):Hide() end end
-- A row click selects it (ref CraftButton_OnClick + SetSelection's non-header path; the -- header-fold branch is dropped, deviation 1). Left-button only. NO OnEnter/OnLeave here — -- Craft's OWN ref never adds a row-hover tooltip (verified, header comment deviation 7). function BenillaCraftSkillButton_OnClick(button, mouseButton) if mouseButton ~= "LeftButton" then return end local index = button.craftIndex if not index then return end BenillaCraftFrame_SetSelection(index) BenillaCraftFrame_Update() end
-- The window's wheel handler (bubbled up the parent chain from a row) → one row via the faux -- kit (TradeSkillFrame.xml's own note: the engine bubbles a spin up the parent chain, so the -- handler lives on the window, not a child). function BenillaCraftFrame_OnMouseWheel(delta) BenillaFauxScrollFrame_OnMouseWheel(getglobal("BenillaCraftListScrollFrame"), delta) end
-- ── The CollapseAll tab (ref CraftCollapseAllButton_OnClick, l.417-425) — TradeSkillFrame.xml's -- own identical shape: toggles Expand/CollapseCraftSkillLine(0) off the button's own `.collapsed` -- flag (re-derived every Update() above), no direct BenillaCraftFrame_Update() call (the ref -- doesn't call one either). UNLIKE TradeSkill's own pair, `Expand`/`CollapseCraftSkillLine` are -- true engine no-ops here (header comment, deviation 1) — no touched flag, no CRAFT_UPDATE, so a -- click changes nothing observably beyond this button's own local state until the next Update() -- runs some other way. ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── function BenillaCraftCollapseAllButton_OnClick(self) if self.collapsed then self.collapsed = nil ExpandCraftSkillLine(0) else self.collapsed = true FauxScrollFrame_SetOffset(getglobal("BenillaCraftListScrollFrame"), 0) CollapseCraftSkillLine(0) end end
-- ── The detail icon (ref CraftIcon OnEnter, l.564-568 — the Ctrl/Shift dressing-room branches -- dropped, deviation 3): SetCraftSpell, NOT SetCraftItem — Craft has no product-item concept -- (craft.rs's own module doc). The binding behind it is a SELECTOR into the shared spell/item -- builders (`SetCraftSpell 0x533e90`); a CREATE_ITEM recipe therefore renders the product's -- full ITEM tooltip here even though the row's ICON is the spell's (Law D) — the two are -- different laws on the same row, byte-verified. ───────────────────────────────────────────── function BenillaCraftIcon_OnEnter(button) if GetCraftSelectionIndex() ~= 0 then GameTooltip:SetOwner(button, "ANCHOR_RIGHT") GameTooltip:SetCraftSpell(GetCraftSelectionIndex()) GameTooltip:Show() end end
-- ── The reagent slots (ref CraftItemTemplate OnEnter, l.31-35 — the dressing-room/chat-link -- OnClick branches dropped, deviation 3) ──────────────────────────────────────────────────── function BenillaCraftReagent_OnLoad(button, index) button.reagentIndex = index local n = button:GetName() button.icon = getglobal(n .. "Icon") button.name = getglobal(n .. "Name") button.count = getglobal(n .. "Count") end
function BenillaCraftReagent_OnEnter(button) GameTooltip:SetOwner(button, "ANCHOR_TOPLEFT") GameTooltip:SetCraftItem(GetCraftSelectionIndex(), button.reagentIndex) GameTooltip:Show() end
-- ── Create / Exit (ref l.654-670 — no Create All, no repeat-count input: deviation 8) ─────── function BenillaCraftCreateButton_OnClick() -- Bare index → spell id, exactly the ref's own OnClick (ref l.667). An ENCHANT_ITEM recipe -- arms an app-side item-target pick from here — this XML plays no part in that (header -- comment, deviation 11). DoCraft(GetCraftSelectionIndex()) end
function BenillaCraftCancelButton_OnClick() HideUIPanel(getglobal("BenillaCraftFrame")) end
-- ── The window lifecycle (MerchantFrame.xml/TradeSkillFrame.xml's own shape) ──────────────── function BenillaCraftFrame_OnLoad(frame) frame:RegisterEvent("CRAFT_SHOW") frame:RegisterEvent("CRAFT_UPDATE") frame:RegisterEvent("CRAFT_CLOSE") -- SPELLS_CHANGED (ref l.58/92-93): a real, non-Beast-Training event (a newly learned enchant -- rank should refresh the list) — registered for fidelity; forward-compatible if this -- engine doesn't fire it yet (TradeSkillFrame.xml's own UNIT_PORTRAIT_UPDATE posture). -- UNIT_PET_TRAINING_POINTS (ref l.59) is NOT registered — nothing left to drive it -- (deviation 6, Craft_UpdateTrainingPoints doesn't exist in v1). frame:RegisterEvent("SPELLS_CHANGED") frame:RegisterEvent("UNIT_PORTRAIT_UPDATE")
local scrollFrame = getglobal("BenillaCraftListScrollFrame") scrollFrame.updateFunc = BenillaCraftFrame_Update end
-- Fresh session paint (ref CraftFrame_Show, l.26-49 — the header index-select branch is -- dropped, deviation 1; the selection-reset itself is ALSO overridden, deviation 10: this -- keeps a persisted selection instead of always forcing index 1). function BenillaCraftFrame_Show(frame) getglobal("BenillaCraftCreateButton"):Disable() if GetCraftSelectionIndex() == 0 then if GetNumCrafts() > 0 then BenillaCraftFrame_SetSelection(1) end else BenillaCraftFrame_SetSelection(GetCraftSelectionIndex()) end FauxScrollFrame_SetOffset(getglobal("BenillaCraftListScrollFrame"), 0) SetPortraitTexture(getglobal("BenillaCraftFramePortrait"), "player") BenillaCraftFrame_Update() ShowUIPanel(frame) end
function BenillaCraftFrame_OnEvent(frame) if event == "CRAFT_SHOW" then BenillaCraftFrame_Show(frame) elseif event == "CRAFT_UPDATE" then -- ref l.68-87: re-anchor the selection if it's fallen off a (possibly shorter) list. local selection = GetCraftSelectionIndex() if selection > 1 and selection <= GetNumCrafts() then BenillaCraftFrame_SetSelection(selection) elseif GetNumCrafts() > 0 then BenillaCraftFrame_SetSelection(1) FauxScrollFrame_SetOffset(getglobal("BenillaCraftListScrollFrame"), 0) end BenillaCraftFrame_Update() elseif event == "CRAFT_CLOSE" then HideUIPanel(frame) elseif event == "SPELLS_CHANGED" then BenillaCraftFrame_Update() elseif event == "UNIT_PORTRAIT_UPDATE" then if arg1 == "player" then SetPortraitTexture(getglobal("BenillaCraftFramePortrait"), "player") end end end
function BenillaCraftFrameCloseButton_OnClick() HideUIPanel(getglobal("BenillaCraftFrame")) end
